notes: This narrow trace maps the portable switch test to the canonical IEEE 1516.1-2025 MOM clause and the pinned IEEE 1516.2-2025 standard MIM. It verifies only the standard federate-specific Service Reporting switch false-to-true-to-false behavior through the public getter; it does not claim complete service-reporting or MOM conformance.

requirements.statement: A joined federate may send individual declared parameters of the standard HLAsetSwitches interaction; HLAserviceReporting sets that joined federate's Service Reporting switch to the provided value, whose default is false.
